SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   D. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

6. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   D. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

12. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

15. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Government Revenue and Expenditure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
